name: Helpdesk for tech and creative needs by TheIToons
author: TheIToons

sections.description:
We created this plugin in response to numerous requests for assistance with basic WordPress issues. Many people are being charged exorbitant fees for simple tasks like setting up a blog or fixing a minor CSS error.

Our goal with this plugin is to provide quick and reliable help for common WordPress questions and issues. While we are equipped to handle more complex challenges, we are always available to discuss your needs if you are in a hurry and prefer not to wait for answers on forums.

Our team possesses a diverse set of skills, including:
* Web Design
* Graphic Design
* UI/UX
* Development (Plugin, Theme, or Customization)
* Social Media Marketing
* Site Security
* SEO

In essence, you can chat with us about any valid WordPress-related question, and we will be delighted to assist you promptly.

Arbitrary section

In case you’ve any query and wanted to get in touch for some reason, please feel free to contact us on prerak (a) theitoons (.) com.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. You’ll have new menu under ‘Dashboard’, named ‘TheIToons Support’
sections.faq:
Q : Who should have this plugin?

A : This plugin is ideal for:
* Busy professionals who don’t have time to manage their WordPress technicalities.
* Bloggers and site owners who need help with making their site/blog better.
* Small business owners who want to enhance their online presence without hiring full-time developers.
* Graphic designers and marketers who need quick technical support for their WordPress projects.
* Educators and students who use WordPress for educational purposes and need assistance.
* Non-profits and community organizations looking for affordable technical support.
* Anyone who prefers a reliable and instant support system over searching for solutions on forums.

Q : What benefits does this plugin offer?

A : This plugin provides a support chat widget directly in your WordPress dashboard (wp-admin). Through this widget, you can instantly connect with our expert team to resolve any design or technical issues you encounter. We offer quick fixes for common problems at no extra charge and guide you to the exact solutions or tutorials you need. Save time and effort by leveraging our expertise to swiftly overcome any WordPress challenges.

Q : Can you give me some examples of when I might need this plugin?

A :

  • Need help finding the perfect plugin? Just tell us your requirements, and we’ll provide a shortlist of the best, verified plugins that are compatible with your WordPress version.

  • Have a specific theme in mind but can’t find it? We’ll help you locate it or even design a custom theme for you at a discounted price, tailored to your needs and preferences.

  • Want to tweak your current theme? Share your vision and give us access to your site; we’ll make the adjustments at no extra charge if it takes just a few minutes.

  • Beyond WordPress technical support, we offer additional services like graphic design, SEO, social media marketing, and user analysis. Need a banner designed and added to your site? We’ve got you covered.

  • Selling physical products and need to enhance your product photos for better conversion? We can help with that too!

  • In short, we are dedicated to helping our customers solve their problems and succeed in their business. That’s the core of TheIToons culture.
